# Reactec

> Reactec provides IoT wearables and analytics software for monitoring and preventing workplace occupational health hazards including vibration, noise, dust exposure, and lone worker risks.

Reactec specializes in workplace safety technology solutions with a focus on hand-arm vibration syndrome (HAVS) monitoring through wearable devices like HAVWEAR and the R-Link smartwatch, complemented by cloud-based analytics and proximity warning systems. The company's ecosystem integrates multiple sensor technologies and data platforms to help organizations manage occupational health risks and comply with health and safety regulations.

## Key Topics

- HAVS (Hand-Arm Vibration Syndrome)
- HAVWEAR vibration monitoring watch
- R-Link smartwatch and proximity warning
- Reactec Analytics cloud platform
- RASOR lone worker monitoring
- NIHL (Noise Induced Hearing Loss)
- Wearable technology
- Occupational health
- Workplace safety
- Risk assessment and prevention
- Dust exposure monitoring
- Vibration exposure measurement
- Ultra-wideband proximity systems
- Worker protection
- HSE compliance

## Core Platform & Products

- [Hand Arm Vibration monitoring solutions to control workplace risks](https://www.reactec.com): Reactec homepage: HAVS monitoring wearables and analytics platform
- [Products: an eco-system of tough workplace wearables](https://www.reactec.com/products): Reactec product ecosystem: wearables, R-Link smartwatch, and analytics platform
- [Analytics Software for Workplace Exposure Risk Data](https://www.reactec.com/products/reactec-analytics): Reactec Analytics cloud platform on Azure for exposure data and risk intelligence

## Workplace Risks & Hazards

- [Workplace Risks](https://www.reactec.com/workplace-risks): Overview of workplace health & safety risks and IoT sensor solutions
- [Hand Arm Vibration Syndrome (HAVS) Risk](https://www.reactec.com/workplace-risks/hand-arm-vibration-syndrome-havs): Guide to HAVS causes, symptoms and prevention from power tool hazards
- [Noise Induced Hearing Loss (NIHL)](https://www.reactec.com/workplace-risks/noise-induced-hearing-loss-nihl): Guide to NIHL causes, prevention and hearing protection in workplaces
- [Dust Exposure Risk](https://www.reactec.com/workplace-risks/exposure-to-harmful-dust): Overview of dust exposure hazards and respiratory disease risks
- [Man Machine Segregation](https://www.reactec.com/workplace-risks/segregation-man-machine): Proximity warning systems and R-Link for vehicle-machinery accident prevention
- [Risks of Working Alone](https://www.reactec.com/workplace-risks/lone-worker-monitoring): Overview of lone worker risks and technology-based monitoring solutions

## Risk Prevention Solutions

- [Risk Prevention](https://www.reactec.com/workplace-risk-prevention): Reactec ecosystem of wearables and analytics for workplace risk prevention
- [Hand Arm Vibration Syndrome (HAVS) Prevention](https://www.reactec.com/workplace-risk-prevention/hand-arm-vibration-syndrome-havs-prevention): HAVWEAR watch and R-Link for HAVS exposure measurement and prevention
- [Proximity Warning Systems](https://www.reactec.com/workplace-risk-prevention/proximity-warning-systems): R-Link proximity warning with ultra-wideband for pedestrian-vehicle safety
- [Noise Induced Hearing Loss (NIHL) Prevention](https://www.reactec.com/workplace-risk-prevention/noise-induced-hearing-loss-nihl-prevention): NIHL prevention through noise monitoring and Reactec Analytics platform
- [Prevention of Dust Related Industry Diseases](https://www.reactec.com/workplace-risk-prevention/preventing-dust-related-industrial-diseases): Dust monitoring with Reactec Analytics and Trolex sensors for disease prevention
- [Supporting Lone Workers](https://www.reactec.com/workplace-risk-prevention/lone-workers): RASOR lone worker support with GPS tracking and man-down detection
